verdict.rationale: Whether IRS online services let users opt out of telemetry, analytics, or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a government web service. The evidence pack documents no such control. The ID.me note that biometric data is automatically deleted concerns identity-verification data retention, not a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
